Every UK accountancy practice, law firm and estate agency is legally required to produce these assessments for each client and to review them periodically, so the demand is mandatory rather than discretionary.

The platform is live and fully operational: Google OAuth and email authentication, Stripe billing across three tiers, an account and billing portal, and three profession-specific assessment templates (Generic, Accountant, Estate Agents) on an extensible template architecture. Reports are generated as editable Word documents that drop straight into a firm's existing document management.

Architecturally it runs a zero-retention model — no assessment data or generated reports are stored on the server. Input is processed in real time, the report is delivered to the user, and the data is discarded. For a product handling client financial information, that removes an entire category of data-protection exposure and support burden from the operator. Maintenance is light: the templates need revision when UK AML guidance moves, which the current owner does, and there is no customer data estate to administer.

Current pricing is £10 per report, £20/month or £200/year for unlimited assessments. That £200 annual ceiling sits well below comparable UK compliance tooling at £40–80/month, and repricing is a same-day change — the product currently charges less for a year of unlimited use than the value of a single assessment it replaces.

Built and maintained alongside an accountancy practice, with no succession for it. sample.title: WriteVoice
sample.summary:
AI dictation that lives in your keyboard - speak naturally on iPhone, Mac or web, and get cleaned-up, ready-to-send text in the tone of the app you're in. WriteVoice is not another transcription app — it's an AI editor that lives in the keyboard. The user speaks naturally, umms and rambling included, and WriteVoice removes the fluff, fixes grammar, structures the thought and outputs ready-to-send text directly inside whatever app is open. Its standout feature is app-aware tone: it detects where you're typing and rewrites accordingly — professional for LinkedIn, casual for WhatsApp. It ships on iPhone/iPad, macOS and web, with newer features like Meeting Notes (rambling thoughts → to-do list) and live translation. Monetization is subscriptions via Superwall.
The numbers are early but verified and moving the right way: $88.99 MRR from 16 subscribers, $122.61 in the last 30 days - up 200% month over month - $1,568 total revenue since the September 2025 launch, an 80% profit margin, and 3,282 website visitors in the last 30 days. The voice-AI wave is cresting right now and this product already rides it with verified 200% monthly growth - the immediate lever is simply more distribution: short-form demos of 'ramble → ready-to-send email' are natural TikTok/Reels material, and the 3,282 monthly site visitors show topline interest is already there. The blog and an SEO push around 'AI dictation' keywords are barely tapped. B2B is wide open: sales teams and founders who voice-note all day would pay team pricing. Localization plus the built-in translation feature opens non-English markets where dictation quality is a bigger pain. An annual plan and a lifetime tier via the existing Superwall setup can lift ARPU with a config change.

sample.title: RonFax
sample.summary:
RonFax provides a secure and user-friendly online faxing service that allows customers to send digital documents to physical fax machines worldwide Every day, people google "fax near me", "how to fax the IRS", "Equifax dispute fax number" - stressed, deadline-driven searches from people who need to send exactly one fax and don't want a FedEx trip or an eFax subscription. 
RonFax is built to catch precisely that intent: landing pages for specific verified destinations - IRS forms, Equifax credit disputes, Aetna prior authorizations, Chase, Capital One - feeding a frictionless flow: enter the number, drop the PDF, pay $1.99 for up to 3 pages, done. 
No account required, which is the whole point: nobody wants a relationship with a fax company, they want their document delivered.

RonFax is a fully automated, developer-friendly Email-to-Fax webhook gateway.

Proven Traction: Generated $85 in the last 30 days with zero paid marketing.

sample.summary:
AI tool that tailors your existing resume to a specific job posting - every change shown line by line, nothing invented, ATS-safe export. Apply Leaf takes the resume a job-seeker already has and tailors it to a specific job posting. Upload a PDF or Word resume, paste the posting, and the AI rewrites it to match what the role actually asks for — the right keywords, the user's real experience, exported as a clean ATS-safe PDF or Word file. The product's whole positioning is honesty: every change is shown side by side before export, the user accepts or rejects each line, nothing is ever invented, and there are no fake match scores — a deliberate contrast to score-driven competitors like Jobscan or Rezi. A matching cover letter is generated against the same resume, and a free tier (first tailored resume free, no credit card) feeds a one-time unlock and a $9/mo plan through Stripe.

What you're buying is a finished, well-positioned product with a working free-to-paid funnel and proof that strangers pay for it. The job-application market is enormous and evergreen; this asset is a distribution play for whoever takes it on. Distribution is untouched and the playbook is proven in this niche: programmatic SEO around job titles and resume templates (a Templates section already exists on the site), short-form TikTok/Reels career content where resume tools reliably go viral, and LinkedIn creators in the job-search space as affiliates. The B2B angle is completely open — university career centers, bootcamps, and outplacement firms buy seats in bulk. Pricing has headroom: the one-time unlock can anchor a higher-tier bundle (resume + cover letter + LinkedIn profile). Peak hiring seasons (January, September) give a new owner two natural launch windows a year.
